The line saying Google didn't respond is plain fact, the flattest line in that stretch. lines.text: Its A I answer said September first.
lines.pace: slight settle on the date
lines.why: Drops under the hook and lets the date register cleanly, because the whole film turns on the viewer remembering it.

lines.text: So on September fifth she shot three snipe.

lines.text: At home she looked up the state regulations and saw her mistake. She called troopers and turned herself in.
